profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Highly motivated and results driven engineer with experience working on front end, back end and cloud native applications

Skills:
•	Languages: Go, Java, JavaScript, Python, HTML, CSS, SQL
•	Technologies: Google Cloud Platform, Big Query, Pub/Sub, Elasticsearch, Contentful (CMS), Aprimo 
        (DAM), Jira, GitHub
•	Frameworks: Vue.js, Node.js, Bootstrap, SASS, Tailwind
•	Platforms: Linux, MacOS
•	Tools: Git, JetBrains IDEs
•	Professional: technical presentations, demos, cross functional teamwork, Agile methodologies

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Migrated content metadata from CMS and DAM systems via Golang pipelines to a cloud data lake
- Transformed raw metadata into analytics ready formats inside of the Big Query data warehouse
- Collaborated cross-functionally with product management and UX team members to deliver business valuable and user friendly solutions in an agile environment
- Engineered search APIs to provide better visibility of content metadata inside of a React web application using Elasticsearch
- Leveraged cloud AI services to auto caption videos, providing an inclusive user experience
- Maintained event driven microservices responsible for enriching our Digital Asset Management system with gigabytes of Product Catalog data

positions.title: Frontend Web Developer
positions.description:
- Created responsive single page web applications using the Vue.js JavaScript framework
- Developed wireframes based off of requirements given by business analysts
- Presented functional prototypes directly to clients
- Evaluated and demoed new libraries and frameworks for senior developers
- Mentored interns in web development using Vue.js
